source_contract: A1-A4 and prospective omissions exactly as AUTUMN_SYNOPSIS_ROOT_DECISION.md; original586 unchanged. Parsed comparison occurs before the parsed explanatory clauses. Unparsed earlier/later text prevents a whole-page source-order certification.
target_scope: All473 rows and12 original fields,24 loci, numeric1..24 order assumed; ZL display, IT/RF literal consequences; no new acquisition or canonical reader.

types.scope: State-free local constructions. Lexical owner names explicitly supply denotations; there is no default owner, mutable weather state or unseen binder. Time owners are supplied by written time expressions. The generic source reading does not select a dated physical episode.

d.law: d(x) = same owner and existing qualifications as x, with DRY appended. No time, recipient, new owner or event is inserted.

qo.law: qo(x) = quoted reason-material record containing exactly x and its condition content. It introduces no because relation, factuality, temporal relation or additional owner.

ar.definition: The summer S under discussion; a named generic season, not a dated observed weather event.

aiin.definition: The autumn A under discussion. Every occurrence keeps this owner.

ain.definition: The melancholic profile M; not an individual patient or the autumn.

dar.definition: Derived d|ar; owner S is preserved.

daiin.definition: Derived d|aiin; owner A is preserved.

qodar.definition: Derived qo|d|ar. It quotes the described condition as reason material; it does not itself assert a causal relation or supply a time.

qodaiin.definition: Derived qo|d|aiin, with the same operations and owner A.

qodain.definition: Derived qo|d|ain. The intermediate dain is computed only inside this form, not claimed as an observed bare word. All three literal occurrences across the readers remain obligations.

sain.definition: Prefix Compare(targetDescription,sourceDescription,respectSet). It asserts resemblance of source and target in the written respects and ascribes each listed quality to both written holders. It does not identify the holders or describe a transformation. These are three paid relation/predication commitments.

or.definition: Prefix Apply(descriptor,namedModifier). T is EntityDescription or SignDescription; the supplied modifier must be an endomorphism on that same T. It preserves owner identity. It is not an untyped cast, binder or truth-to-entity conversion.

opchdy.definition: Append the COLD qualification to the supplied owner-preserving description. A first-class modifier value, applied only by the declared application production.

qotor.definition: The same dry-attachment operation used by component d, supplied as an independently paid whole modifier value.

sheedy.definition: A paid whole alias for the same M denoted by ain. No extra person is created.

shodaiin.definition: Prefix PairRespect(q1,q2), retaining the two written quality values.

olfar.definition: Cold as an explicit quality argument, distinct in type from the modifier function opchdy.

ary.definition: Dry as an explicit quality argument.

pchedeey.definition: Prefix Because(resultCondition,groundCondition), using the shared factive reason-giving kernel. Both conditions are asserted generically within this historical synopsis; no empirical intervention or state update.

olkey.definition: Prefix Cold(description), preserving its owner. Same quality operation as opchdy, through a separately paid direct-application surface.

sheos.definition: The sun, explicitly the holder of the course condition.

fcheey.definition: Head after its written Sun subject, followed by a source-direction qualifier, a destination qualifier and a written temporal nominal. This describes a generic course/tendency, not an accomplished entry into winter.

otchedy.definition: Prefix AwayFrom(group). The ground has an explicit deictic group argument; no latitude, residence or geographic place is inferred.

chotey.definition: The source-discourse us, introduced by this explicit deictic term. The actual membership is unspecified. No figure or external personal metadata supplies it.

qocthey.definition: Prefix IntoSigns(winterSignModifier): apply the supplied modifier to a generic sign-class descriptor and return a course-direction qualification. INTO and SIGNS are two paid payloads.

oteey.definition: Qualify the sign class as winter signs. Does not assert that a winter event has happened.

ol.definition: Prefix definite nominal marking over EntityDescription or TimeNominal, preserving its denotation and sort. It cannot turn a temporal qualifier into an entity or a noun into a function.

oloqorain.definition: TimeOf(A), paid as a two-payload whole nominal (time relation plus autumn owner). No new cycle/date is introduced.

qotaiin.definition: Infix result EXPLAINED_BY factualScopedGround. Same reason-giving kernel as pchedeey, through a separately paid surface and input interface.

tchedy.definition: Prefix FrameGround(frame,factualGround); the explicit frame qualifies the ground, not the entire following passage.

otedy.definition: Prefix EarlierThan(the written TimeNominal). No default anchor or automatic temporal state update.

ytchedy.definition: Prefix make explicit the quoted ground as an asserted generic condition, preserving its owner/property and adding no time. The declaration is a paid assertion-status operation.

qotedar.definition: Prefix Precedes(season,the written time). Its subject is the written summer; TimeOf of the season subject is the declared left temporal projection, not a changed owner.

qotchd.definition: Same TimeOf function as qotchdy; a separately paid whole alias.

grammar.name: Lexical nominals
grammar.definition: Named season/profile/celestial terms denote A,S,M and Sun; the explicit deictic term denotes an unspecified us. No individual patient, dated year or latitude is introduced. Generic historical predication is not a measured-event claim.

grammar.name: Finite lexical composition
grammar.definition: Only the five explicitly declared cuts are derived by d and qo. Other d/o/qo-looking forms remain whole unknowns or separately listed whole values. No universal prefix deletion or full morphological parser is claimed.

grammar.name: Named modifier application
grammar.definition: or D F applies a supplied NamedModifier[T -> T] to D:Descriptor[T], for T=EntityDescription or SignDescription. The operator/function is explicitly a lexical value; arbitrary quoted operators, unknown lambda tables and owner-changing coercions are not licensed.

grammar.name: Direct cold application
grammar.definition: olkey D applies COLD to that written EntityDescription. The separate opchdy interface supplies the corresponding named modifier as data. These are paid surface choices, not independently confirmed inflections.

grammar.name: Respect construction
grammar.definition: shodaiin Q1 Q2 yields the ordered pair/set of the two quality arguments. No quality is inferred from a drawing, name or phrase length.

grammar.name: Comparison
grammar.definition: sain Target Source Respects forms CompareIn(Source,Target,Respects), also ascribing each written quality to the two written owners. The first expression provides an explicitly modified target. This is not identity, causation, a patient change or a rule for all members of a biological population.

grammar.name: Course clause
grammar.definition: SunTerm fcheey (otchedy Group) (qocthey WinterModifier) TimeNominal forms Course(Sun,awayFrom(Group),into(WinterSigns),at(TimeNominal)). The final temporal nominal is a declared syntactic temporal adjunct; no separate unwritten AT token is alleged. All four roles are written. This constructor introduces no global referent register.

grammar.name: Definite nominal
grammar.definition: ol N marks the explicit nominal as definite while preserving its sort and referent. TimeNominal stays temporal, EntityDescription stays an entity description.

grammar.name: Prefix reason-giving
grammar.definition: pchedeey ResultDescription Ground asserts ConditionOf(ResultDescription), Ground and Because(Ground,ConditionOf(ResultDescription)). The result description must have at least one written qualification; the explicit G16 interface supplies its condition. The two complete argument expressions supply their own owners and qualifiers. The result is exactly the supplied condition.

grammar.name: Before frame and time projection
grammar.definition: otedy Time produces Before(Time). qotchdy Season and qotchd Season produce TimeOf(Season), through two paid whole spellings of the same function.

grammar.name: Factual scoped ground
grammar.definition: ytchedy QuotedGround preserves its content and marks it asserted; tchedy Frame FactualGround applies the frame to that ground. The temporal qualifier does not migrate to the result or a subsequent clause.

grammar.name: Infix reason-giving
grammar.definition: QualifiedResultDescription qotaiin ScopedGround uses the same Because kernel as G09, preserving the full scoped ground. This is an additional fixed surface/interface, not a per-occurrence gloss change.

grammar.name: Earlier relation
grammar.definition: qotedar Season Time states that the time of the written season precedes the written time. In C4 both the summer subject and autumn temporal owner are written.

grammar.name: Clause completion and limits
grammar.definition: Complete typed Proposition expressions may form successive statements. No line end is a sentence operator. Bare nominals, modifiers, before-frames and quoted grounds are not by themselves completed statements. No gap skipping, reset, free cast, source-inferred reference or unrestricted higher-order escape is licensed.

grammar.name: Permitted unknowns for preflight
grammar.definition: Unknown literal forms have no meaning yet. Sort requirements recorded in the table are obligations, not permission to invent an arbitrary phrase macro. This partial supplies no new global parser or proof that all unknowns can be completed.

grammar.name: Written description-to-condition interface
grammar.definition: d, cold attachment and dry attachment produce owner-qualified descriptions. The qo reifier and the two because constructors explicitly use ConditionOf(D) = conjunction of the written qualifications of D applied to its retained owner. This interface requires a nonempty qualification list; it is not a global cast from every noun/reference to a proposition. This additional semantic construction is paid explicitly. No time is inserted by ConditionOf.

manual_clauses.surface: sain or or aiin opchdy qotor sheedy shodaiin olfar ary
manual_clauses.reading: The melancholic profile and autumn match in the written cold/dry respects. Autumn is explicitly modified as cold and dry; the comparison ascribes these respects to both supplied owners.

manual_clauses.surface: pchedeey olkey qokedy sheos fcheey otchedy chotey qocthey oteey ol oloqorain
manual_clauses.reading: Autumn coldness is explained by the sun’s course away from us into winter signs at autumn-time. The generic course/tendency is not a completed winter event.

manual_clauses.surface: daiin qotaiin tchedy otedy qotchdy chckhey ytchedy qodar
manual_clauses.reading: Autumn dryness is explained by dryness of summer in a time preceding that autumn-time. The earlier qualifier belongs to the summer ground, and the result still belongs to A.
The summer time precedes the autumn time. This repeats the temporal relation explicitly; it supplies no measured duration.

all_occurrence_preflight.finding: Every exact occurrence is the same named owner descriptor. Bare nouns do not complete a statement; all outside clause ownership remains owed. No extra owner is supplied to make an unparsed adjacency work.

Every literal is a derived dry description of S or A. The local C3 result is daiin. A bare dar occurrence elsewhere has not been supplied a complete sentence merely because embedded d|ar computes inside qodar.

All exact ground forms are derived by the same d/qo laws, including the third owner M and the IT S.16 qodain reading. Only qodar receives a completed local reason use. qodaiin and qodain outside are quoted grounds, not free clauses or different word senses.

Every occurrence requires a written TimeNominal. Outside C3, .1 G002 requires the following opaees/opoees to participate in a TimeNominal expression. IT .1 G007 also has otedy and requires an actual time expression beginning otar. No default anchor is inserted.

Every literal requires a HumanGroup argument and yields an AwayFrom qualifier. The two ZL/IT annular occurrences require actual group expressions beginning olkaiin and qotedaiin; their surrounding course syntax has not been completed. RF variant otche@152;y is unassigned.

Every occurrence is typed modifier application. N.2 has two actual nested applications. S.13 requires a descriptor beginning shedy and a compatible modifier expression; these remain unassigned. S.15 across the next line encounters fixed oteey: a direct completion with am as the first operand would require am:SignDescription, because oteey modifies sign descriptions. W.20/22 applications beginning aiin/ain require owner-preserving EntityDescription modifiers. Outside .24 requires a descriptor and a matching named modifier, not an implicit reference reset. IT aiinog and RF split forms are not normalized.

Each occurrence demands a nominal argument and preserves its sort. The local temporal nominal at E.8 is supplied. Annular lkech variants and W.23 lcheol/sheoly are unassigned nominal obligations; a later grammar cannot silently use ol as AT or as a type cast.

Fixed as the winter modifier of sign descriptions in both E.8 and S.16. Its latter placement is an actual constraint on the uncompleted S.15–16 application, not a second freely chosen winter-time noun.

Occurrence IDs, immediate literal neighbors, output types and required input sorts are retained for every row. Single-occurrence assigned constructors also have their explicit children in the local derivations. Unknown sorts are not successful parses.

revision_history_before_first_freeze.choice: Considered quality roots with predication/causal lifts. No completed whole argument or frozen values resulted; do not report this as a tested failure.
Named owners ar=S, aiin=A, ain=M; d attaches DRY, qo quotes a condition as reason material. This gives actual differently owned d applications in C3, while retaining all three qod forms.

An attempted ol=AT reading conflicted with possible nominal uses elsewhere. It was not frozen or counted as a manuscript result. Current ol is definite nominal marking; the written TimeNominal in C2 supplies its own adjunct role.

or is explicit named-modifier application over EntityDescription or SignDescription. The second descriptor class is needed by the repeated winter-sign modifier. This is a paid type/interface choice, not evidence of its meaning.

A prospective W.18/W.20 qokal=BECAUSE plus shedy=solar-course reference would make the W.20 result owner M through or ain, unless an extra owner-changing projection or root alias were added. No such qokal/shedy binding, projection or ain=aiin alias is adopted. This was a genuine whole-occurrence warning before freeze, not a contradiction of the retained partial or of all completions.

Self-review made the result-description versus proposition interface explicit: qo and the because constructors project only nonempty written owner qualifications through G16. No general DescriptionRef-to-assertion cast or predicate-to-owner inversion is introduced.

Did not complete the .1 annulus or the remaining page without additional loosely motivated declarations, synonymous owner references and scope/projection operations. The local source accounting is not a complete page reading. No global UNSAT claim.
